items.title: Top 5 Strongest Gravity in the Solar System (Earth Is #5) #shorts
items.description:
A 70 kg person on a bathroom scale, on five worlds. On #1 the scale reads almost 2 tonnes.
Full video: What If the Moon Crashed Into Earth? You'd Have 4 Days

Sources
• NASA planetary fact sheets (NSSDC): surface gravity Earth 9.80, Saturn 10.44, Neptune 11.15, Jupiter 24.79, Venus 8.87, Uranus 8.87 m/s² (gas giants measured at the 1-bar pressure level)
• NASA Sun Fact Sheet (NSSDC): surface gravity 274.0 m/s²
• NASA fact sheets: masses Uranus 14.5, Neptune 17.1, Saturn 95.2 Earths
• Own calculations: scale reading = 70 kg × g ÷ 9.80 (Saturn 74.6, Neptune 79.6, Jupiter 177, Sun 1,957 kg); a 50 cm jump on Earth reaches 50 × 9.80 ÷ g

Visuals are original. Narration uses a synthetic voice.
#shorts #space #gravity #solarsystem

items.title: 986 Jupiters Fit Inside the Sun. Weigh Them and You Get Almost the Same Number #shorts
items.description:
986 Jupiters fit inside the Sun by volume, and the Sun weighs 1,048 Jupiters. Why so close? Their average densities are almost the same.
Full video: What If Jupiter Became a Star? It Would Need 80 Jupiters

Sources
• NASA Sun Fact Sheet (NSSDC): volume 1,412,000 × 10^12 km³, mean radius 695,700 km, mass 1,988,500 × 10^24 kg, mean density 1,408 kg/m³
• NASA Jupiter Fact Sheet (NSSDC): volume 1,431.28 × 10^12 km³ (1,321 Earths), mean radius 69,911 km, mass 1,898.13 × 10^24 kg, mean density 1,326 kg/m³
• Own calculations: Sun volume ÷ Jupiter volume ≈ 986; Sun diameter ÷ Jupiter mean diameter ≈ 9.95; Sun mass ÷ Jupiter mass ≈ 1,048
• NASA: the Sun and Jupiter are both made mostly of hydrogen and helium

Visuals are original. Narration uses a synthetic voice.
#shorts #space #sun #jupiter

items.title: There's a Galaxy in Your Sky 6 Times Wider Than the Moon. You've Never Seen It #shorts
items.description:
Andromeda spans about 3 degrees of sky, six full Moons side by side. Your eyes only catch its core.
Full video: Why Can't We See the Edge of the Universe? Far Galaxies Look Bigger

Sources
• NASA Hubble Messier Catalog, Messier 31: Andromeda is about six times the apparent diameter of the full Moon and can be seen with the unaided eye from dark skies; about 2.5 million light-years away
• ESA (Flyeye image of Andromeda, 2025): in angular size it is about six times the diameter of the full Moon
• The full Moon spans about 0.5° of sky; Andromeda's visible disc about 3° (long exposures)
• Smithsonian Human Origins Program: Homo sapiens appeared about 300,000 years ago

Visuals are original. Narration uses a synthetic voice.
#shorts #space #andromeda #galaxy
